meta.topic: 化妆教程 · 骨相 · 方圆脸

scenes.title_en: Find the Inner and Outer Contours
scenes.context: 先用眼尾-嘴角连线、眉峰垂直到发际线、嘴角垂直到下巴，把脸分成内外轮廓。语域：化妆教学，分步讲解。
sentences: 我们要先找到脸的内外轮廓。
First, we need to find the inner and outer contours of the face.
inner and outer contours（内外轮廓）
眼尾与嘴角连线。
Connect the corner of your eye to the corner of your mouth.
corner of your eye（眼尾）；corner of your mouth（嘴角）
把这几条线连接起来。
Link these guide lines together.
guide lines（参考线）
paraphrase: 内外轮廓 → inner and outer contours / the face contour map
连线 → connect / draw a line from A to B
scenes.speak: First, we need to find the inner and outer contours of the face. Connect the corner of your eye to the corner of your mouth, and link these guide lines together.

scenes.context: 外轮廓粉底液色号比内轮廓暗，粉扑垂直拍开，先内后外，出自然折叠度。语域：化妆教学，分步讲解。
sentences: 外轮廓的粉底色号比内轮廓暗一些。
Use a foundation shade darker on the outer contour than the inner.
foundation shade（粉底色号）；darker（更暗）
用粉扑垂直拍开，先内后外。
Pat it in vertically with a sponge — inner area first, then outer.
pat it in（拍开）；vertically（垂直）
脸部就有自然的折叠度。
Your face gets a natural sense of depth.
sense of depth（折叠度/立体感）
paraphrase: 拍开 → pat it in / blend it in
折叠度 → sense of depth / facial dimension
scenes.speak: Use a foundation shade darker on the outer contour than the inner. Pat it in vertically with a sponge — inner area first, then outer. Your face gets a natural sense of depth.

scenes.context: 骨相立体的脸型侧面是平行四边形阴影：平行分界线到脸侧发际线、平行下颌线到颧骨，中间留白。语域：化妆教学，方法讲解。
sentences: 骨相立体的脸型，侧面都是平行四边形阴影。
Bony, sculpted faces have a parallelogram of shadow on the side.
sculpted face（骨相立体脸）；parallelogram of shadow（平行四边形阴影）
从分界线平行到脸侧。
Run a line parallel to the contour boundary toward the temple.
parallel to（平行于）；temple（太阳穴/脸侧）
中间是留白的。
Keep the middle area free of shadow.
free of shadow（留白）
paraphrase: 立体脸型 → sculpted face / defined bone structure
平行 → parallel to / run parallel with
留白 → keep it clear / leave it free
scenes.speak: Bony, sculpted faces have a parallelogram of shadow on the side. Run a line parallel to the contour boundary toward the temple, and keep the middle area free of shadow.

scenes.context: 膏状或液体修容更融肤自然：平行分界线拍打到脸侧、平行下颌线到颧骨、额头两侧垂直拍。语域：化妆教学，实操演示。
sentences: 用膏状或液体的修容更融肤自然。
Cream or liquid contour melts into the skin more naturally.
melts into the skin（融肤自然）
平行于下颌线到颧骨。
Go parallel to the jawline up to the cheekbone.
jawline（下颌线）；cheekbone（颧骨）
额头两侧不要忘记。
Don't forget the sides of your forehead.
sides of your forehead（额头两侧）
paraphrase: 融肤自然 → melts into the skin / blends naturally
scenes.speak: Cream or liquid contour melts into the skin more naturally. Go parallel to the jawline up to the cheekbone, and don't forget the sides of your forehead.

scenes.title_en: Nose Contour and a V on the Tip
scenes.context: 沿鼻子本身的阴影加深：山根画弧、鼻头V字形、向内晕染；横画一笔让鼻头更翘。语域：化妆教学，实操演示。
sentences: 沿鼻子本身的阴影加深即可。
Just deepen the nose's own natural shadow.
natural shadow（本身的阴影）
从山根起笔画弧线。
Start from the bridge and draw an arc.
bridge of the nose（山根）；draw an arc（画弧线）
鼻头画一个V字形。
Draw a V shape on the nose tip.
V shape（V字形）；nose tip（鼻头）
paraphrase: 山根 → bridge of the nose / nose bridge
加深 → deepen / intensify the shadow
scenes.speak: Just deepen the nose's own natural shadow. Start from the bridge and draw an arc, then draw a V shape on the nose tip.

scenes.title_cn: 眼部骨相轮廓与眉骨提亮
scenes.title_en: Eye Bone Contour and Brow-Bone Highlight
scenes.context: 眼部同样是平行四边形阴影：山根到眼窝、眼尾与眉尾连接；眉骨一定要提亮出明暗对比。语域：化妆教学，分步讲解。
sentences: 眼部轮廓和脸侧一样，是平行四边形阴影。
The eye area is like the side of the face — a parallelogram of shadow.
eye area（眼部轮廓）
从山根向眼窝凹陷处画阴影。
Shade from the nose bridge into the hollow of the eye socket.
hollow of the socket（眼窝凹陷处）
眉骨处一定要提亮。
Always highlight the brow bone.
brow bone（眉骨）；highlight（提亮）
paraphrase: 眼窝 → eye socket / the hollow under the brow
scenes.speak: The eye area is like the side of the face — a parallelogram of shadow. Shade from the nose bridge into the hollow of the eye socket, and always highlight the brow bone.

scenes.context: 液体提亮涂内轮廓的额头、下巴、面中三角区；鼻梁竖提、鼻头横提；颧骨斜打腮红与眼尾阴影平行。语域：化妆教学，实操演示。
sentences: 鼻头横向提亮，鼻梁竖线提亮。
Highlight across the nose tip and down the bridge vertically.
highlight across（横向提亮）；vertically（竖线）
在颧骨位置斜打腮红。
Sweep the blush diagonally over the cheekbone.
sweep diagonally（斜打）
斜打能修饰阔面感。
The diagonal sweep slims a wide-looking face.
slims a wide-looking face（修饰阔面感）
paraphrase: 斜打 → sweep diagonally / apply at an angle
修饰阔面感 → slim the wide look / narrow the face
scenes.speak: Highlight across the nose tip and down the bridge vertically. Sweep the blush diagonally over the cheekbone — the diagonal sweep slims a wide-looking face.

scenes.context: 骨相妆容眉毛更英气：眉头顺山根下压、刀锋眉笔逐根画、染眉膏统一；唇部画饱满显大气。语域：化妆教学，实操演示。
sentences: 眉头顺着山根向下压。
Press the brow head down along the nose bridge.
brow head（眉头）；press down（下压）
用刀锋眉笔一根一根画。
Draw the hairs one by one with a razor-sharp brow pencil.
razor-sharp brow pencil（刀锋眉笔）
嘴唇往饱满了画更大气。
Fill the lips out fuller — it looks more polished.
fuller（更饱满）；polished（大气）
paraphrase: 眉头下压 → press the brow head down / lower the brow head
画饱满 → fill out / make fuller
scenes.speak: Press the brow head down along the nose bridge, and draw the hairs one by one with a razor-sharp brow pencil. Fill the lips out fuller — it looks more polished.

practice: Connect the corner of your eye to the corner of your mouth.
Use a foundation shade darker on the outer contour than the inner.
Run a line parallel to the contour boundary toward the temple.
Always highlight the brow bone to sharpen the contrast.
pitfalls: I sweep my eyeshadow on directly.
Don't sweep it straight on — press the shadow in first, then blend upward.
眼影要先按上去再向上晕染，直接扫会把粉扫到未定妆的脸颊。
I apply the same highlight for everyone.
Pick the highlight tone by your skin: warm for yellow undertones, cool for fair skin.
提亮颜色要跟肤色：黄皮用暖调、白皮用冷调。
I line outside my lips and stop there.
After lining outside the lip line, blend inward with a small brush.
唇线画完后必须向内晕染，否则会化成大嘴巴。
I'm afraid to contour because powder setting will erase it.
Cream contour fades a little under setting powder but stays — don't be afraid to apply it.
膏状修容定妆后会变淡但不会被盖掉，可以放心画。
shifts: 用 inner and outer contours（内外轮廓）、parallelogram of shadow（平行四边形阴影）、fold depth（折叠度）精确描述
只会说 make my nose higher
用 deepen the natural shadow（沿本身阴影加深）、V shape on the nose tip（鼻头V字形）、horizontal line（横画一笔）
只会说 my makeup looks flat
用 contrast of light and shadow（明暗对比）、highlight the brow bone（眉骨提亮）、diagonal blush（斜打腮红）说明立体感来源
